data_limitations: us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss is an EXACT IDENTITY mapping to the `operating_income` metric for every filer.

AAPL's cash-flow line 'Depreciation and amortization' is carried on us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortization for FY2008 to FY2016 and on us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization from FY2015, so the two overlap on FY2015 and FY2016 and both are annual only before FY2018. The FY2018 10-K restates FY2016 on the successor at 10,105 million against the 8,300 million first filed, which the lane records as a prior-period value revision. AAPL tags its quarterly cash-flow depreciation on us-gaap:DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet until the FY2018 third-quarter 10-Q, an element the registry does not accept and this role does not read, so the earliest four-quarter window the lane can build is FY2018. us-gaap:Depreciation is pure depreciation and is not read. The registry accepts both elements this role reads.

Cover-page shares outstanding, taken as filed and never adjusted for a split, paired with the as-traded close. AAPL has two splits in the price series's range: 7:1 on 2014-06-09 and 4:1 on 2020-08-31.

The capture's acceptance index covers the issuer's periodic filings only, so a fact first published in another form becomes knowable in this lane at the next periodic filing that carries it. The lane therefore never uses a value before it was public, and it may use a value later than it first became public.

formula.denominator: the trailing twelve months of AAPL's reported operating income plus reported depreciation and amortization, each a discrete fiscal quarter, summed over four consecutive quarters
formula.expression: (as-traded close x cover-page shares outstanding) / TTM of (us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss + us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization)
formula.numerator: as-traded close on the evaluation date times the latest knowable cover-page shares outstanding

production_refusal.statement: No production reference is created from this distribution, and none may be created from it.

DepreciationAndAmortization.basis: The core registry maps us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortization to 'depreciation_and_amortization' for AAPL as an EXACT IDENTITY mapping, without a filer restriction. The element is this metric for this filer, and its filed values may produce a figure.

DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization.basis: The core registry maps us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization to 'depreciation_and_amortization' for AAPL as an EXACT IDENTITY mapping, scoped to AAPL. The element is this metric for this filer, and its filed values may produce a figure.

OperatingIncomeLoss.basis: The core registry maps us-gaap:OperatingIncomeLoss to 'operating_income' for AAPL as an EXACT IDENTITY mapping, without a filer restriction. The element is this metric for this filer, and its filed values may produce a figure.

EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding.basis: The role names no registry metric, so the registry has no standing to rule on the element. The lane's own specification governs the role, and the element is read under it.

distribution.research_use_label: RESEARCH USE ONLY. This distribution is computed from filed evidence that the production qualification regime does not admit. It is not a valuation reference, it is not a production reference chain input, and it must not be presented as one.

unit_policy.scale_basis: AAPL states its amounts in units; the capture holds them unchanged and no scaling is applied.

observation_lineage: The committed summary carries one line per evaluation date. The full lineage -- every operand, accession, element, period, unit and usable date -- is regenerated exactly by the lane from the capture, whose files are hashed in the capture manifest.
